posts.body: Published Oct 15, 2026, 1:05 PM: Researchers at the American College of Gastroenterology's 2026 meeting in Nashville found ischemic colitis in 5.5% of hospitalized patients with documented endurance activity, versus 2.0% of matched controls, roughly triple the odds, with risk climbing for ultra-distance events [per Medical Daily](https://www.medicaldaily.com/endurance-athletes-ischemic-colitis-acg-2026-479868). posts.title: Pi 1.0, an open-source coding agent, cuts tokens 40%
posts.excerpt: Pi 1.0's Codemode lets the model call tools through short JavaScript instead of rereading every tool description each turn, cutting prompt tokens by about 40%. It is an MIT-licensed,…
posts.body: Pi 1.0's Codemode lets the model call tools through short JavaScript instead of rereading every tool description each turn, [cutting prompt tokens by about 40%](https://tech-insider.org/pi-1-0-coding-agent-tokens-cut-2026/). It is an MIT-licensed, provider-agnostic terminal agent, so the harness costs nothing and the only bill is whichever model you point it at.

posts.body: The unofficial storefront that served free game downloads to jailbroken PS5s no longer works, and its GitHub page now returns a 404, with Sony Interactive Entertainment the likely party behind the takedown [according to Notebookcheck](https://www.notebookcheck.net/Sony-reportedly-shuts-down-free-PS5-game-store-accessed-with-console-jailbreak.1423408.0.html). The app's disappearance lands alongside Sony's firmware 14.00 and 14.10 updates, which blocked the Relapse exploit outright.

posts.body: Duane "Keffe D" Davis, 63, was sentenced Tuesday to two consecutive 20-years-to-life terms for orchestrating the 1996 drive-by shooting that killed Tupac Shakur in Las Vegas, per [Daily Nation](https://nation.africa/kenya/news/world/how-keffe-d-s-own-words-finally-solved-tupac-s-murder-5631102). The case against him was built largely on his own words: media appearances, a memoir, and tapes of his secret meetings with investigators.

posts.title: A calm heart the night before is tied to faster marathon times
posts.excerpt: Published Oct 14, 2026, 7:00 AM: Of the 73 male marathoners tracked with a single-lead ECG patch the night before the 2025 Padua Marathon, those with a lower minimum sleeping heart rate and stronger…
posts.body: Published Oct 14, 2026, 7:00 AM: Of the 73 male marathoners tracked with a single-lead ECG patch the night before the 2025 Padua Marathon, those with a lower minimum sleeping heart rate and stronger vagal modulation finished faster the next day, independent of age, BMI, and training hours, [per the Oct 12 study in Frontiers in Cardiovascular Medicine](https://www.frontiersin.org/journals/cardiovascular-medicine/articles/10.3389/fcvm.2026.1932814/full). The authors read the pattern as a readiness signal: stronger vagal tone overnight may mark more restorative sleep, and that recovery is the preparedness that shows up the next morning.

posts.title: Chainguard puts CI checks inside the agent loop
posts.excerpt: Published Oct 14, 2026, 4:25 AM: Chainguard announced Checks on Wednesday, a verification engine that pulls CI out of its old spot after the pull request and runs it inside the agent's working loop,…
posts.body: Published Oct 14, 2026, 4:25 AM: Chainguard announced Checks on Wednesday, a verification engine that pulls CI out of its old spot after the pull request and runs it inside the agent's working loop, delivering signed, trusted verification in seconds, per its [PR Newswire release](https://www.morningstar.com/news/pr-newswire/20261014ne71672/introducing-chainguard-checks-reinventing-continuous-integration-for-the-agentic-era). Every passing run produces a signed attestation tying together the environment, test result, and commit, so a merge gate can verify it and merge without re-running the test suite.
